summary_claims.claim: Two companion technical guides from J-AISI for AI developers and providers.
summary_claims.original_quote: 本書は、AI システムの開発及び提供の過程に関与する事業者（AI 事業者ガイドラインに記載されている「AI 開発者」及び「AI 提供者」 ）を読者とする。
summary_claims.literal_translation: This document is addressed to business operators involved in the process of developing and providing AI systems (the 'AI developers' and 'AI providers' described in the AI Guidelines for Business).

summary_claims.claim: Version 1.20 adds 'observation and control' for AI agent systems.
summary_claims.original_quote: さらに、AIエージェントシステム特有の観点として「観測と制御」を設け、「自律的な挙動」及び「外部環境との相互作用」に関する評価項目を追加しました。
summary_claims.literal_translation: In addition, 'observation and control' was set up as a perspective specific to AI agent systems, and evaluation items on 'autonomous behaviour' and 'interaction with the external environment' were added.

summary_claims.claim: The other sets a methodology for red-teaming AI systems, including LLM-based systems.
summary_claims.original_quote: RAG（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）の仕組みを実装したAIシステムに対して実際にレッドチーミングを行い、その手順を詳細に解説するとともに、レッドチーミング実施の成果物を文書としてとりまとめました。
summary_claims.literal_translation: We actually carried out red teaming on an AI system implementing a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) mechanism, explained the procedure in detail, and compiled the outputs of the red-teaming exercise as documents.

issues: language field lists English, but the English versions are J-AISI translations of the Japanese guides (marked 'Please refer to the original text for accuracy' per the web lead); proposed 'Japanese'.
'Including LLM-based systems' is not stated literally in stored text: the release page mentions a RAG system, and the red-teaming guide itself is not stored.
note: The v1.20 evaluation guide cites the AI Guidelines for Business as version 1.2 (page 9), which bears on JP-02. The guide's section 5.1.2 (page 43) confirms the companion relationship: it refers readers to the red-teaming guide for 'レッドチーミングの意義、実施する場合の想定フロー、実施者の役割、実施する場合の留意事項等'.
